title: HiAP: A Multi-Granular Stochastic Auto-Pruning Framework for Vision Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2603.12222v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision Transformers require significant computational resources and memory bandwidth, severely limiting their deployment on resource-constraint hardware. Most structured pruning methods reduce theoretical cost effectively, yet they typically operate at a single structural granularity and depend on multi-stage pipelines with importance ranking, auxiliary solvers or post-hoc magnitude thresholding, followed by a separate fine-tuning phase to recover accuracy. We propose Hierarchical Auto-Pruning (HiAP), which casts ViT pruning as a single budget-aware learning problem and jointly allocates sparsity across four granularities in one end-to-end phase. HiAP introduces stochastic Gumbel-Sigmoid gates at macro level (attention heads and FFN blocks) and micro level (intra-head dimensions and FFN neurons), and trains them against the task loss together with an analytical MAC cost term. translated_title: HiAP：一种面向视觉Transformer的多粒度随机自动剪枝框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.12222v3 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：视觉Transformer需要大量的计算资源和内存带宽，严重限制了它们在资源受限硬件上的部署。大多数结构化剪枝方法能有效降低理论成本，但它们通常操作在单一结构粒度上，并依赖多阶段流程，包括重要性排序、辅助求解器或事后幅度阈值，随后还需要单独微调阶段来恢复精度。我们提出了层次化自动剪枝（HiAP），它将ViT剪枝视为一个单一预算感知的学习问题，并在一个端到端阶段内联合分配四种粒度的稀疏性。HiAP在宏观层面（注意力头和FFN块）和微观层面（头内维度和FFN神经元）引入了随机Gumbel-Sigmoid门控，并针对任务损失连同解析MAC成本项一起训练它们。预算系数引导网络达到目标...
tldr: HiAP通过一个端到端阶段联合优化四种粒度的稀疏分配，利用随机Gumbel-Sigmoid门控和解析MAC成本项，实现了无需多阶段流程的ViT自动剪枝。
en_tdlr: HiAP jointly optimizes sparsity allocation across four granularities in a single end-to-end phase using stochastic Gumbel-Sigmoid gates and an analytical MAC cost term, enabling automatic ViT pruning without multi-stage pipelines.
